cases_at_least_1s.name: makes an agent's tsc, vitest, eslint, jest and playwright wait for a slot however they start, and nothing else
restores folded inbox mail of a failed carrier whose program never answered it, none
keeps 25 letters that come while a person talks with the head in her inbox, and gives them in one turn after it
lets a person's words go before the letters that waited
gives the letters that waited with the next turn on a task, so the turn for the inbox never waits behind newer turns
gives every message that waited on the same task in one turn, and keeps a message on another task and a person's words apart
wakes a holder whose task waits with a turn on that task that has the letter whole, and ends the wait as before
keeps a letter on a task for a turn on that task, so its holder cannot wait past it
fails a letter on a task that cannot go out alone: the sender hears it, the wait goes on, and nothing of it waits unread
takes a person's words that came by Telegram or an assistant as a person's, not as mail
shows each employee only its own letters, cut short, and no task text it does not see
keep a comment that goes into the turn on its task in the inbox as read with that turn
keep each comment that joins a turn already waiting on its task in the inbox with that turn
list the unread letters by task and sender, and mark them read or dealt with
opens an employee's inbox to the CEO and to the owner of its department only
logs a skipped assignment on done without waking anyone
logs a skipped assignment on cancelled without waking anyone
does not let a person answer an internal stuck request through the agent's terminal
answers the agent's question with a message in its window, and leaves a commit to approve open
keeps the work with Bruno once his turns worked on it, as what he did may not be pushed yet, and he goes on on a fallback plan
waits for the reset when none of them could start now: signed out, its machine off or its node too old
asks the member head to answer the internal stuck request
wakes whoever holds the task now when its head answers
excludes queue time from silence and resumes alarms after a normal quiet interval
waits, says why, and starts by itself once memory frees up
does not hold the turn of an agent whose program already runs there
keeps only live snapshots for a personal node and accepts older messages
delivers 2 missed messages once in the same session, new company round: true
go out in one turn on their task once the node is back, and do not make the agent look stuck
leaves none of several tasks stuck or waiting once the machine is back
neither reminds the agent nor clears its quiet turns for a turn from the backlog that ended without a word
does not count the continuation of a turn from the backlog that failed before it recorded its work
still asks the head once the agent went on for eight turns without handing anything in
counts a turn that went out before its node dropped for a moment and came back
lets one turn after its return go uncounted, and still asks the head about an agent that keeps going on
lets one quiet turn after its return go uncounted, and still asks the head about an agent that stays quiet
keeps running and queued conversations through a 60-second disconnect and accepts the result after return
keeps a turn on a task whose machine is away, tells whoever gave the task once, and goes on when the machine is back
ends a turn of someone who does not hold the task as before, and closes the note of a kept turn that ended
counts a turn on a done subtask for its parent
recovers the assignee of an old open task once per move
recovers the assignee of an old working task once per move
recovers the assignee of an old review task once per move
recovers Tests after a passed Review without waking the former checker
recovers the head for a wrong-goal escalation without returning work to its author
keeps repeated ordinary findings with the checker without calling in the head or author
leaves work waiting when it is request
sends B when pumping past the word deadline
keeps B waiting when only the first of two words is unheard
holds B after the old job ends, opens queued words, then sends B after their answer
